# Third-party notices · 第三方资产说明

KChart's own source code and documentation are under the [MIT License](LICENSE). The bundled third-party assets below keep their own licenses and trademark notes. In the npm package, the files linked here are under `dist/`.

- Icons: a curated subset of Tabler Icons v3.46.0 (MIT) and Simple Icons 16.28.0 (CC0 1.0, with brand trademark notes). See [assets/ICONS-LICENSE.txt](assets/ICONS-LICENSE.txt). The package ships the subset compiled into its icon module; the source data is `packages/kchart/assets/icons.json` in the repository.
- Maps: world and US state boundaries from Natural Earth, in the public domain. See the [map license](assets/maps/LICENSE.md), [display conditions](assets/maps/METADATA.md) and [region keys](assets/maps/REGIONS.md). No approved China boundary data is included.
